response.justification: Bogdan brings 15+ years of deep, polyglot engineering experience including genuine high-throughput/low-latency distributed systems work (Sociomantic/Dunnhumby) and current hands-on exposure to AI-agent infrastructure and MCP tooling, which aligns well with the AI-native mindset the role demands. However, Python — an explicit must-have — is absent from his skills and work history entirely, and his resume shows little concrete evidence of the stakeholder-management, cross-functional technical-strategy, or operational/on-call ownership expected at Staff level, despite title inflation across several roles.
strengths: Deep, diverse technical background including genuine high-throughput distributed systems experience (Sociomantic/Dunnhumby micro-services handling millions of requests/sec)
Current role directly involves AI-agent infrastructure and MCP code generators, closely matching the AI-native engineering mindset required
Strong TypeScript/Node.js expertise plus broad polyglot range (D, C++, Java, C#) showing systems thinking and adaptability
concerns: No evidence of Python experience anywhere in skills or work history, despite it being an explicit must-have
Resume is heavily IC/technical-implementation focused with little demonstrated stakeholder management or cross-functional technical-strategy work
Only ~4 months in current Staff-level title with no mention of on-call/incident response ownership or agile ceremony participation

key_factors.factor: Hands-on AI-agent/MCP tooling experience in current role
